'''Terror Eel''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite}} {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Terror Eel}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Crash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Thrash
|Intent = Attack2, Buff
|Effect = Deals (3x3;{{Asc2|9|4x3}}) damage. Gains 6 {{BD2|Vigor}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Vigor
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Stun
|Intent = Stun
|Effect = Stunned. Does nothing.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Terror
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 99 {{BD2|Vulnerable}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Vulnerable
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Terror Eel alternates between {{Int2|Terror Eel|Crash}} and {{Int2|Terror Eel|Thrash}}, starting with {{Int2|Terror Eel|Crash}}. Because {{Int2|Terror Eel|Thrash}} gives the Terror Eel 6 {{BD2|Vigor}}, {{Int2|Terror Eel|Crash}} always deals 22({{Asc2|9|24}}) damage from turn 3 onwards.

When its HP drops to its {{BD2|Shriek}} threshold (70, or {{Asc2|8|75}}), it becomes {{KW2|Stunned}} and then uses {{Int2|Terror Eel|Terror}} before resuming the Crash/Thrash cycle.

* {{Int2|Terror Eel|Terror}} applies 99 {{BD2|Vulnerable}}, which effectively makes the player take 50% more damage from attacks for the rest of the fight.

== Trivia ==
* Terror Eel's name and {{Int2|Terror Eel|Terror}} skill are a reference to the card {{C|Terror||1}} from Slay the Spire.
